name: second-brain
description: A PARA-based personal second brain backed by a portable Markdown vault in Google Drive.

interface.longDescription: Turn conversations into durable, reusable context using PARA. Second Brain stores and recalls a portable Markdown/Obsidian-style vault in Google Drive while keeping persistence explicit and preserving raw Markdown.
